inherits.from_alpha_sweep_r1: ONLY the hypothesis DEFINITIONS of P3_VOL_EXPANSION_DIR and X3_HTF_REGIME_COND. No R1 return statistic is carried over; everything below is recomputed from the raw snapshots.
inherits.thresholds_changed_vs_r1: NO (rv window 5 bars, regime quantile q67 trailing, sigma window 20, z5 cut 2.0, donchian/trend window 60 bars, horizons 1/5/15/30/60 min, cost 0.914bp)

EXTENDED.definition: union(MAIN, PIT2) deduplicated on the exact ts_utc value, then re-sorted and re-segmented
EXTENDED.purpose: expand the time sample WITHOUT changing any PIT definition
EXTENDED.note: the two snapshots overlap on 2026-09-21..09-22; duplicates are removed on ts_utc only

data.bars: 1m bars per segment, a bar is usable at its close (PIT)
data.volume: volume/volume_real/last are 0 on 100% of ticks in BOTH snapshots => every flow feature is a QUOTE-BASED PROXY

P3.definition: rv5 = trailing 5-bar std of 1-bar returns; regime = causal trailing q67 of rv5 (expanding, min 100 bars); trigger = onset of the high-vol regime (rv5 crossing from below q67 to at/above q67); direction = FOLLOW sign(ret1) of the trigger bar; entry = first tick with ts > the trigger bar close; exit = mid at the first tick with ts >= entry + h
P3.VALIDATED_EDGE_requires: cost-positive on IS AND OOS at 1x, permutation p<0.05, bootstrap CI excluding 0, effective_n>=30, survives 2x, no single-bucket dependence, and the same sign on MAIN and EXTENDED

X3.definition: |z5|>=2 AND 60-bar change > 0 AND ret5 > 0 -> LONG (always direction +1); entry = first tick with ts > trigger bar close

nulls.definition: LONG at exactly the same entry ticks as X3, ignoring all of X3's conditions
nulls.purpose: isolate the direction component from the signal component

nulls.definition: LONG at every 1m bar close in the same segments (a broad always-long control)
buy at the first tick and hold to the end of the sample (market baseline)

verdict_rule.BETA_EXPLAINED: the same-times unconditional LONG captures >= 70% of X3's gross at every horizon at which X3 is positive
verdict_rule.ALPHA_SUPPORTED: X3 beats the same-times unconditional LONG by a margin that is cost-positive AND permutation-significant (not expected here)

X3.forbidden: no change to the X3 rule to improve its performance
